verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a public catalog of more than 23,000 payment-gated resources from many sellers, and its discovery APIs need no CDP API key. Agents can search by intent with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through an OpenAPI client, the TypeScript SDK, or the Bazaar MCP server. Sellers are listed automatically with no registration or partnership, and a runtime probe confirmed a keyless GET returned real listings. Missing for 10: the catalog covers x402-gated HTTP services rather than general merchant product catalogs; search returns at most 20 results; no hands-on test of the intent search endpoint itself (the probe hit the list endpoint).
